gloss: sashimi; artfully arranged sliced raw fish

definitions.gloss: sashimi; artfully arranged sliced raw fish
definitions.explanation: A polite or refined term for sashimi, emphasizing the careful preparation and artistic presentation. Commonly used in the Kansai region and in formal dining settings.

examples.japanese: お{造|つく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I ordered an assorted sashimi platter.
Today's sashimi is sea bream and yellowtail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕食|ゆうしょく}→夕食：03006_yuushoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧なお{造|つく}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was impressed by the magnificent sashimi served at the inn's dinner.

notes:
USAGE:
お{造|つく}り is a more refined way to say ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧. It is the standard term in the Kansai region and is commonly used on menus at higher-end restaurants and traditional Japanese inns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{造|つく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧ (assorted sashimi platter)
- ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{造|つく}り (today's sashimi)
- お{造|つく}り⟦{五|ご}→五：00697_go⟧⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧⟦{盛|も}り→盛り：13696_mori⟧ (five-variety sashimi platter)

REGIONAL NOTE:
In Kansai, お{造|つく}り is the default term, while ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ is more common in Kanto. In formal dining contexts nationwide, both are used.
